_note: Sources for the science wire.
This is a feed on research integrity, not science news. A discovery is not
the subject; what is wrong with the published record is.
Retraction Watch is in direct and was checked directly: the site is live,
running WordPress and posting daily, so /feed/ is its standard endpoint.
PubPeer is NOT in direct, and cannot be: it publishes no public RSS feed,
only a keyed API you would have to request from them. It is covered by an
events search instead, which catches PubPeer threads once someone reports
on them — Retraction Watch does so constantly — but not the raw comments.
If you want the comments themselves, email PubPeer for API access and add
a small fetcher; the harvester's source format would need a new block for
it, since everything here speaks RSS.
direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
This is the weakest direct list of any feed built here, and honestly so:
almost nothing in the sibling repos covers research integrity, so the
carried-over feeds contribute little. The events block and the specialist
additions below are what will actually make this wire work.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for retraction tracking, paper mills, metascience,
institutional investigations and publishing policy.
standing is provenance, not importance:
official  funders, institutions, integrity offices, courts
research  journals, publishers, metascience
press     general news across the locales
rights    open science and accountability organisations
Add these first, with URLs you have opened: Retraction Watch, PubPeer,
Nature news, Science news, Times Higher Education, Chemistry World, the
Committee on Publication Ethics, the Office of Research Integrity, MetaROR,
and the Center for Open Science.
